_meta.source: The restaurant's current printed menu, photographed page by page and supplied for transcription (October 2026).
_meta.note: Transcribed from the current printed menu. Dish names, descriptions and prices are the restaurant's, not ours. Descriptions are verbatim including print quirks ("Mixer of Spinach", "adds a edge"); one obvious spacing typo was normalized ("car damom" to "cardamom" in Rasmalai). Entrees are served with rice or butter naan; 18% gratuity applies to parties of 6 or more — both printed on the menu itself.
unverified: No dish is marked vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free or nut-free - no dietary data exists in the source, and none has been invented.
Allergen information is not available and is deliberately absent.
Category names are taken from the printed headings; Biryani / Rice and Chawal / Rice are merged (see mergeNotes).
Chilli Paneer appears on the printed menu in two places (Appetizer at $13.99 and Paneer at $18.49) - shown as printed, not resolved.

mergeNotes.noteOnMerge: The printed menu carries two rice sections (Biryani / Rice and Chawal / Rice). Both are served here under Rice & Biryani; every dish from both sections is present exactly once.
